metadata.description: Curated demo subset of the iteration-5 'transplanting the base model's plan' artifact (Qwen3-8B vs Qwen3-8B-Base): Stage 4 confirmation slots of the two most informative decisive tasks, plus the frozen commits the Stage-8 analysis code reads.
metadata.selection: tasks T14 and T03; S2 slots j 10-19 (N = 50 per arm and task); every committed Stage-4 arm
metadata.example_format: one example per CRN slot (task, template, slot); output = the unhooked instruct twin (TWIN) as 'label|pass'; predict_<arm> = that arm's 'label|pass' on the same slot (arm names with '.' and '-' replaced by '_', e.g. predict_T1_0 = T(lambda = 1.0))

commit1.lambda_selection_rule: lambda*_t = argmax correct off-default share (among correct) over lambda in {0.25, 0.5, 1} with pass >= 0.8 x pass(twin S1); ties -> smaller; none -> UNTESTED
commit1.validity_gate: T(0.25) pass < 0.8 x twin on more than half of the tasks with a default -> UNTESTED
commit1.mr_breakage_rule: MR(lambda*) BROKEN if pass < 0.8 x twin (S1, MR(lambda*) cell when run, else the nearest MR grid point); lambda' = the largest grid lambda with an unbroken MR; none -> ISO(1)
commit1.reverse_rule: default share among correct (primary) and among parseable attempts (co-primary) rises by >= 0.5 x (instruct twin share - base twin share)

branches: specificity failed (READ moves or collapsed tasks move)

geometry.note: within-band panels (S18, S23) put T(lambda) points on the instruct-base segment by construction; S27 and R are informative
